title: Upgrade Blob Storage section to reference blobext-01
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Blob Storage section: upgrade reference from RFC 9404 to also cover draft-ietf-jmap-blobext-01 (IETF track, capability URI urn:ietf:params:jmap:blob2, obsoletes RFC 9404). Add a note that servers SHOULD support Blob/lookup with 'Message' registered as a participating data type (so clients can find all messages referencing a given blobId/attachment). Add a note that servers MAY support Blob/convert for image media types (thumbnails). Note that the sha256 field in the jmap-chat upload response extension already aligns with blobext conventions.
